provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-18 for the CTO-authorized M11 targeted boundary experiment (paired with boundary_pair3_a_applicable_learning_guidance_present). claim: Management indicated operating margin will continue to expand next quarter.
evidence: Financial excerpt: Operating margin was 32.1% in the current quarter, compared to 30.0% in the prior-year quarter. This disclosure covers only the quarter just completed and does not include forward guidance.
reference_rationale: The claim is about forward-looking management guidance; the evidence explicitly self-scopes as covering only the completed quarter and states it does not include forward guidance. The claim and evidence are not about the same subject (guidance vs. a completed-quarter actual) -- distinct from UNSUPPORTED, where evidence at least addresses the same subject without confirming the specific claim. Independently justified from the evidence's own explicit scoping language, not constructed to force a contrast with Case A.
